chunks: Sahl, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Safwan, from Al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams) (peace be upon them), that he said:

'Do not drink while you are standing, nor urinate in stagnant water, nor walk around a grave, nor be isolated in a house alone, nor walk in one shoe, for the Satan is quickest to be with the servant when he is in one of these states.'
And he said: 'If anything were to befall anyone in this state, it would hardly leave him, unless Allah, Mighty and Majestic, wills otherwise.'
ai.seo_question: What are the specific actions and states that make Satan quickest to approach a person according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights specific physical postures and solitary states that facilitate spiritual vulnerability, reflecting the Shia emphasis on maintaining mindfulness (muraqabah) against the whispers of Satan. The narration underscores the concept that these seemingly minor actions create an opening for spiritual harm, reinforcing the need for constant divine awareness in daily life.

en.hubeali:
Sahl, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Safwan, from Al A’ala, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:

‘Do not drink while you are standing, nor urinate in stagnant water, nor spit by a grave, nor be isolated in a house alone, nor walk in one shoe, for the Satan<sup>la</sup> is quickest as he<sup>asws</sup> can be to the servant when he was upon one of these states’.
And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If anything were to hit anyone upon these states so it would not separate from him except if Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic so Desires it’.
en.sarwar: 8. Sahl has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from Safwan from al-‘Ala’ from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “One of the two Imam, (abu Ja‘far or abu ‘Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam, has stated this Hadith.

‘You must not drink water when you are standing, must not urinate in stagnant water, must not spit on a grave, must not stay in a house alone, you must not walk in one shoe; Satan is the fastest against a servant when he is in one of such conditions.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘If one becomes affected in any one of such conditions, it will not leave him unless Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, wants otherwise.’”
